title: Tech View Columns menu shows a count, Show all and Reset to default
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has it).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. A brand-new user who has never changed any Work Orders columns (e.g. "Nora New", created under Settings > Staff with an Admin role), signed in in this browser for the whole case.
  5. At least 1 technician is eligible at this location (e.g. "Esther Howard"). A staff member is eligible when Clockable is on, the staff record is Active, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member, enter a first and last name (e.g. "Esther Howard") and an email.
    • Pick a role that is not Office or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), turn Clockable on, keep the record Active, enrol the staff member at this location, then Save.
  6. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  7. Create the work order: Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the case customer (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") and its asset > create it, and write down its number (e.g. "S1-702").
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician to "Esther Howard".
    • On the Lines tab click New Line, enter a name (e.g. "Brake inspection") and labor hours (e.g. 2.0), and save the line.
    • Click the line's Approve (check) button so the work order status reads Approved.
custom_steps:
1. As Nora New, open Work Orders.
  2. Click the All tab.
  3. Type the case customer's name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") in Search.
  4. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (in the design its tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
  5. Write down every column heading in Esther Howard's group.
  6. Click the Columns button in the toolbar (in the design its tooltip reads "Columns").
  7. Read the menu heading, the count beside it and the two buttons at the bottom of the menu.
  8. Untick one ticked column (e.g. "Created on").
  9. Read the count and the column headings in Esther Howard's group.
  10. Click Show all.
  11. Read the count and the column headings.
  12. Click Reset to default.
  13. Read the count, the column headings and the Reset to default button.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 7: the menu is headed "Columns" with a count in the form "<ticked> of <offered> shown" (e.g. "10 of 10 shown"), and the bottom of the menu offers "Show all" and "Reset to default". Reset to default is greyed out and cannot be clicked, because Nora has not changed anything yet.
  • Step 9: the count goes down by exactly one (e.g. from "10 of 10 shown" to "9 of 10 shown") and the unticked column disappears from the Tech View rows at once, without reloading the page.
  • Step 11: Show all ticks every column the menu offers, the count reads "<offered> of <offered> shown" (e.g. "10 of 10 shown") and every one of them is a heading in the rows.
  • Step 13: Reset to default puts back exactly the columns written down in step 5 (Tech View's starting columns, the same as List's default columns) and the Reset to default button is greyed out again.
  • Step 7: columns that are always shown (for example Number and Status) are not listed in the menu and stay in the rows whatever is ticked. The design labels and the "<n> of <m> shown" wording come from the design system: write down the words you see, a different label alone is not a fail.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10048 (Story 5, Fields to display (Board View) and columns (Tech View)); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S5-R1, S5-R4, read 8 Oct 2026. Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Branko Cicovic, Claude Design project 787fef1a, Work Orders.dc.html) renders its toolbar through the design system bundle _ds/shopview-design-system-fac6efcf…/_ds_bundle.js: the Columns menu (columns-dropdown.jsx, bundle L349-L659) shows the "Columns" heading, "<n> of <m> shown", "Show all" and "Reset to default" (disabled while the default set is shown), and the Work Orders screen hides the always-on columns from it (bundle L11935-L11939, hideLocked). Design crawl 8 Oct, Tech View state 0, Columns click: "Columns | 10 of 10 shown | Show all | Reset to default". Design-only details (count, Show all, Reset to default, greyed state) are cited to the design; the starting set comes from the PRD. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R1: “Tech View has its own optional-column selection, separate from List. Changing columns in Tech View never changes List, and changing columns in List never changes Tech View.”
  • S5-R4: “Until the user changes Tech View’s columns, Tech View shows the current production List default columns.”
